initiative.title: Trustworthy metrics and ranking
initiative.summary: Correct measurement meaning, availability, ownership and comparison before adding metric families.
initiative.next_action: Review the proposed scope, then execute the measured-zero versus unavailable scan proof.

sources.anchor: 2026-10-15 original unique-information request and full-process approval

sources.authority: external proposals checked against baseline; not product intent

sources.location: server/app/models.py; server/app/services/analysis_types.py; server/app/services/analysis.py; server/app/services/reporting.py; client/src/components/Explorer.tsx; client/src/utils/metricsStore.tsx

claims.statement: Provide unique actionable information per metric.
Avoid several highly correlated metrics that add little information.
Review current metrics and the field including CRAP before proposing initiatives.
Research and planning are authorized; application implementation remains planned.
Correct measurement meaning, availability, ownership and comparison before adding metric families.

shape.appetite: Small isolated local proofs; no enterprise infrastructure or compatibility layers.
shape.problem: Correct measurement meaning, availability, ownership and comparison before adding metric families.
success_moves: Start with one real scan/report instead of redesigning all analyzers.
Use capability declarations and explicit exceptional states before per-value wrappers.
Use one current contract and direct ranking implementations with shared fixtures.
Reproduce area and selection failures before changing their code.

first_proof.question: Can one scan preserve executable ownership and distinguish zero from unavailable end to end?
first_proof.artifact: TS/Python scan fixture, report and explorer detail.
first_proof.decision_rule: Proceed only if all expected populations, states and maximum source locations agree.

repository_snapshot.worktree_status: Research/planning documents only; no application implementation.
test_commands: cd server && uv run pytest tests/test_complexity_semantics.py tests/test_synthetic_scopes.py tests/test_reporting.py

dependencies.name: Existing analyzers and scope/area attribution
dependencies.application_seam: analysis_types.py scope identity and analysis.py node construction

first_proof_role.rationale: The first outcome depends on actual analyzer output; hand-built nodes alone cannot establish propagation.

dependencies.local_proof: Small checked-in source fixtures with expected populations and exceptional analyzer outcomes.
dependencies.live_proof: No external provider; run installed analyzers in the local scan and browser fixture.
dependencies.rollout: Optional input or coherent commit; omit/revert without parallel API support.

fast_local_loop.command: cd server && uv run pytest tests/test_complexity_semantics.py tests/test_synthetic_scopes.py tests/test_reporting.py
fast_local_loop.status: Proposed commands for implementation; new scripts/tests do not exist yet.

milestones.title: A scan distinguishes executable evidence from unavailable data
milestones.outcome: A scan/report/explorer distinguishes real executable scopes, measured zero and unsupported analysis.
milestones.proof: Focused pytest and local browser check on TS/Python plus skipped-file fixture.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: A scan/report/explorer distinguishes real executable scopes, measured zero and unsupported analysis. Existing source-only scanning remains usable.
milestones.rollback: Revert the scoped milestone commit or omit optional evidence; no stored-data migration.

milestones.title: Measures conserve their declared units
milestones.outcome: Source units, display area, counts and per-function summaries agree with hand-declared cases.
milestones.proof: Area-union fixtures, real-function denominator cases and all metric support assertions.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: Source units, display area, counts and per-function summaries agree with hand-declared cases. Existing source-only scanning remains usable.
milestones.rollback: Revert the scoped milestone commit or omit optional evidence; no stored-data migration.

milestones.title: Ranking and selection tell one consistent story
milestones.outcome: UI and report compare the same cohort with monotone scores and current selected evidence.
milestones.proof: Shared cohort UI/report parity, fixed-peer monotonicity, selected-scope/filter browser checks.
milestones.valid_intermediate_state: UI and report compare the same cohort with monotone scores and current selected evidence. Existing source-only scanning remains usable.
milestones.rollback: Revert the scoped milestone commit or omit optional evidence; no stored-data migration.

cut_line: New metric families, general type checking, compatibility layers and registry generators.
Persistent review states, longitudinal identity, trend services and a visual redesign.
Automatic metric deletion or default selection based solely on correlation.

history.change: Created planned initiative from collected Pro research and independent source checks. Application proofs remain unrun.
